mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals recessionary pressures that cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO growth rate < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate > 0.0% does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals sustained economic confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery phase, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST growth rate > 1.0%.
